name: Goi la sau dau
nameVi: Khô cá lóc trộn gỏi lá sầu đâu
summary: Dried snakehead tossed with sầu đâu leaves, the salt of the fish against the astringent leaf, with a bowl of mắm me on the side.
origin: Đồng Tháp Mười, in the old Long An half of Tây Ninh. Dried snakehead from kênh 79 is the base of the plate.
taste: The salt of the fish meets the astringent sầu đâu leaf.
howToEat: Dip each bite in the mắm me served with it.
where: The drying yards along kênh 79 and the markets that sell khô cá lóc, plus orchard and countryside tourism stops.
seoTitle: Goi la sau dau in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Dried snakehead tossed with astringent sầu đâu leaves and tamarind fish sauce.
